Heels on Wheels Monday Ride

Little Rock, AR · River Market · Road · Social

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendly

Heels on Wheels Monday Ride is a road and social group ride in Little Rock, AR. It rolls every Monday at 5:30 pm from William J. Clinton Presidential Library. About 12–15 miles, beginner.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Heels on Wheels Monday Ride group ride

A women's cycling group with a beginner-pace Monday evening ride from the Clinton Library along the river trail. Twelve to 15 miles. The group also rides Thursday evenings from the Big Dam Bridge and Saturday mornings from the submarine in North Little Rock.
